svg.text: A4 BELT & BLADE — conveyor bed, powered blades, no force
Food rides a washable belt past fixed, oscillating blades: the belt meters every cut, rolls Rouladen in a pocket and lays food into the pan.
wet cell 800 W × 520 D × 600 H (module 900 W)
Roulade 20 s · Schnitzel 45 s · slices from 1 mm
vessel / cradle / pan on weigh pad
roller · platen · sifter · tray · freeze platen · syringe
Close-up: the belt pocket rolls a Roulade (no tying)
slice with filling → pocket opens → rollers close, belt runs → tight roll, seam down
Close-up: dicing in two passes, beyond the nose
pass 1: G1 cuts slabs → return tray lays them flat · pass 2 (top view): G2 makes strips, G1 makes cubes
No blade ever cuts against the belt: a knife mark on the belt would be a hygiene defect.
1/8 A roast drops from the dock chute onto the belt.
2/8 The belt feeds it into the nose gap; the oscillating cross blade cuts — belt advance = slice thickness.
3/8 Roulade: the freeze platen on the rocker lays a beef slice; the syringe station rasters mustard on it.
4/8 The belt brings the slice to the pocket; the dancer drops 60 mm and the slice sags into the pocket.
5/8 The pocket rollers close to 12 mm and the belt runs: the slice rolls itself up into a tight Roulade.
6/8 The pocket opens; the belt carries the roll over the nose into the cradle, seam down.
7/8 Schnitzel: the roller flattens it, the sifter crumbs it, the belt lays it into the pan.
8/8 Wash: the belt runs three turns through scraper, spray bar (40–80 °C) and air knife on its return run.
